breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.

Although the torsion formulas (τ_max = Tc/J and φ = TL/(JG)) correctly use J, the continued presence of I = π d^4/64 as a calculation step repeats the original error rather than eliminating it as the ground truth does.
